title: auth-svc TLS certificate expired — all auth endpoints 503
description: Wildcard TLS cert for auth.company.com expired at 2024-06-15T02:00:00Z. cert-manager auto-renewal was not configured. All downstream services that depend on auth-svc (order-svc, payment-svc, inventory-svc) are now unable to authenticate. 100% 503 rate. Renewal commit f1a2b3c4 deployed at 02:45Z restored service.

title: Add cert-manager auto-renewal and 30-day expiry alerting for all production certs
description: Post-incident action: configure cert-manager to auto-renew all production TLS certificates 30 days before expiry. Add PagerDuty alert at T-30d and T-7d. Audit all other services for manually managed certificates.
